ModMetaData.name: More Religious Origins
ModMetaData.author: Kirby
ModMetaData.description:
This mod adds more religious structures, and some styles associated with them. Styles include sculptures and ideograms, and miscellaneous furniture and architectural elements like columns, lamps, and chairs Currently Daoism, Shinto, Norse, Hellenic, Egyptian, Aztec, and Druidic are implemented. Daoist and Shinto can build incense shrines Norse and Hellenic can perform animal sacrifices Aztec can perform prisoner sacrifices Druidic can perform effigy burnings
Future plans include adding more styles, and expanding styles to include things like furniture, floor slabs, and so on
